description_en: Queries the distribution of request source countries for website services within a specified time period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内网站业务的请求来源国家分布
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-view-source-countries --resource-group-id default --start-time 1582992000 --end-time 1583683200 --domain www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainViewSourceCountries

parameters.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
parameters.description_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or half hour.
parameters.description_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
> 必须为整点分钟。
